title: Topological Hall plateau in quasi-2D kagome magnet YMn$_6$Sn$_6$
summary: We examine the impact of the Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction (DMI) in kagome magnets and show that a predominantly planar DMI together with ferromagnetic exchange stabilizes a disordered skyrmion phase in quasi-two-dimensional (2D) YMn$_6$Sn$_6$. Within an ab initio framework combining density functional theory and spin-dynamics simulations, we generate realistic spin textures of disordered skyrmion and find that this phase persists for $B_{ext} < 0.5$ T, with a decreasing skyrmion size as magnetic field increases. We demonstrate the emergence of topological Hall plateau in the range $-0.5 \leq B_{ext} < 0.5$ T, driven by nearly uniform scalar spin chirality and the resulting constant real-space Berry curvature. This response is anti-symmetric with magnetic field while magnitude and sign of these plateau are determined by a complex interplay between Hund's coupling strength and chemical potential signifying the role of Dirac points and van Hove singularities. In addition, we reveal topological magnon excitations in the disordered skyrmion phase of quasi-2D YMn$_6$Sn$_6$.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过第一性原理计算和自旋动力学模拟，研究了Kagome磁体YMn₆Sn₆中由Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用（DMI）和铁磁交换稳定化的无序斯格明子相，揭示了其拓扑霍尔效应平台和拓扑磁振子激发。
AI.motivation: 探讨Kagome磁体中DMI对拓扑自旋结构的影响，理解无序斯格明子相的形成机制及其拓扑响应特性。
AI.method: 结合密度泛函理论（DFT）和自旋动力学模拟的从头算框架，生成真实的自旋织构，分析外加磁场、Hund耦合强度和化学势的影响。
AI.result: 无序斯格明子相在B_ext<0.5T范围内稳定存在，斯格明子尺寸随磁场增大而减小；在-0.5≤B_ext<0.5T区间出现拓扑霍尔效应平台，该平台由均匀标量自旋手性和实空间贝里曲率驱动，其符号和大小受Hund耦合与化学势调控。
AI.conclusion: 准二维YMn₆Sn₆中的无序斯格明子相具有丰富的拓扑电子和磁振子激发特性，为Kagome磁体中的拓扑物理学提供了新见解。

title: Structure-Dependent Chemical Order Modification in Strained Alloy Nanoparticles
comment: Manuscript: 17 pages, 5 figures; Supporting Information: 10 pages, 7 figures, 6 Tables
summary: Alloy nanoparticles (nanoalloys) exhibit tuneable physicochemical properties that depend sensitively on their atomic arrangement, making control over chemical ordering a central challenge in nanomaterials design. While most theoretical studies consider nanoalloys in vacuum, practical systems are typically supported, where strong cluster-substrate interactions can introduce significant lattice strain. Here, we investigate strain as a control parameter for chemical ordering in bimetallic nanoalloys using atomistic molecular dynamics and Monte Carlo simulations. By imposing controlled tensile and compressive strain through an implicit anchored interface, we systematically probe the response of NiPt nanoparticles with distinct structural motifs. For truncated octahedral particles, we find that chemical ordering and segregation behaviour remain remarkably robust even under large strains, indicating that intrinsic thermodynamic preferences dominate. In contrast, icosahedral nanoparticles exhibit pronounced strain-induced chemical redistribution, with a significant increase in surface Ni concentration under tensile strain. This behaviour is attributed to the combined effects of intrinsic geometric frustration and a high fraction of undercoordinated sites in icosahedral structures. Our results demonstrate that strain can selectively modulate chemical ordering in nanoalloys in a structure-dependent manner, establishing a general framework for understanding strain-induced chemical ordering in nanoalloys.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分子动力学和蒙特卡洛模拟，研究了应变对双金属NiPt纳米合金化学有序化的调控作用。发现截角八面体纳米颗粒的化学有序化对应变不敏感，而二十面体纳米颗粒在拉伸应变下表面Ni浓度显著增加，表明应变可选择性地调控纳米合金的化学有序化。
AI.motivation: 纳米合金的化学有序化对其物理化学性质至关重要，但大多数理论研究只考虑真空中的纳米合金，而实际体系通常有基底支撑，基底与团簇间的相互作用会引入晶格应变。因此，作者希望探究应变作为控制参数来调控双金属纳米合金化学有序化的可能性。
AI.method: 采用原子级分子动力学和蒙特卡洛模拟，通过隐式锚定界面施加可控拉伸和压缩应变，系统研究不同结构构型（截角八面体和二十面体）的NiPt纳米颗粒在应变下的化学有序化响应。
AI.result: 截角八面体颗粒的化学有序化和偏析行为在大应变下仍保持稳健，表明内在热力学偏好占主导；而二十面体颗粒在拉伸应变下表面Ni浓度显著增加，表现出明显的应变诱导化学再分布，归因于几何阻挫和高比例欠配位位点的共同作用。
AI.conclusion: 应变能以结构依赖的方式选择性调控纳米合金的化学有序化，为理解应变诱导的纳米合金化学有序化建立了通用框架。

title: Dominant-pair free energies predict phase selection in high-entropy alloys
summary: Phase selection in multicomponent alloys is governed by the competition between entropic stabilization of disordered solutions and enthalpic driving forces for chemical ordering. However, widely used parametric criteria reduce it to a single scalar, carrying no explicit free energy for any competing ordered phase. Herein, we develop a thermodynamic framework based on the semi-empirical macroscopic atom model and the Dinsdale lattice stability database to fill this gap. We show that a dominant-pair mechanism, in which the Al-transition-metal interaction family dominates the ordering enthalpy, enables the complex multicomponent B2-ordering problem to be reduced to an effective pseudo-binary system with an analytically evaluated Bragg-Williams free energy. Combined with a minimum-free-energy classifier, the framework predicts the lowest-energy phase as a function of composition and temperature. This provides continuous phase stability maps rather than the single-value predictions of conventional descriptors. Demonstrated on high-entropy alloys using a dataset of 269 experimentally characterized samples, the model outperforms widely used phase-selection criteria in the class-balanced macro-F1 metric and achieves 77.9% on the well-posed three-class task, outperforming the valence electron concentration criterion. The model is general by construction and computationally efficient for predicting phase stability in multicomponent alloys over a broad range of compositions and temperatures.

AI.tldr: 本文基于半经验宏观原子模型和Dinsdale晶格稳定性数据库，开发了一个热力学框架，通过优势对机制将复杂多组分B2有序化问题简化为有效伪二元系统，并用Bragg-Williams自由能和最小自由能分类器预测相稳定性，在269个高熵合金数据集上优于传统判据，达77.9%宏F1分数。
AI.motivation: 现有相选择判据将多组分合金的相选择简化为单个标量，无法承载竞争有序相的自由能信息，缺乏 thermodynamics 基础。
AI.method: 基于半经验宏观原子模型和Dinsdale晶格稳定性数据库，提出优势对机制（Al-过渡金属相互作用主导有序焓），将多组分B2有序化简化为有效伪二元系统，解析计算Bragg-Williams自由能，结合最小自由能分类器预测最低能相。
AI.result: 在269个实验表征的高熵合金样本上，模型在宏F1指标上优于广泛使用的相选择判据，三分类任务达77.9%，优于价电子浓度判据。
AI.conclusion: 该框架可生成连续相稳定性图而非单值预测，通用性好且计算高效，适用于宽成分和温度范围内的多组分合金相稳定性预测。

title: Anomalous bulk dealloying below the parting limit
summary: Dealloying has been extensively studied both as a corrosion degradation mechanism in structural materials, including those used in nuclear, aerospace, or marine environments, and as a versatile method to fabricate porous materials for catalysts and other functional applications. Classical dealloying theory in aqueous environments predicts a critical reactive-element concentration (parting limit) for continuous selective dissolution at temperatures where bulk diffusion does not dominate; this threshold is commonly reported around 50~60 at.%. Yet recent studies show that molten salt environments can generate extensive bulk dealloying below this threshold. Despite the importance of this anomalous dealloying behavior in many energy systems and electrochemical applications, its fundamental origin remains elusive. Here, we address this critical gap, revealing a grain boundary (GB)-assisted bulk dealloying mechanism. Using three-dimensional (3D) reconstruction of the dealloyed regions correlated with crystallographic and elemental analyses, we directly map the 3D GB-void architecture and reveal that diffusion-induced recrystallization (DIR) generates a high-density GB network, which then promotes molten-salt infiltration and can drive bulk dealloying far-below the conventionally reported parting limit, producing a distinctive morphology reminiscent of discontinuous precipitation (DP). Understanding this dynamic GB-void interplay is crucial for the prediction and control of dealloying in complex electrochemical environments.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了熔盐环境中低于经典脱合金化极限（约50~60 at.%）的异常体脱合金化机制，发现晶界辅助的扩散诱导再结晶过程可产生高密度晶界网络，促进熔盐渗透并驱动远低于传统 parting limit 的体脱合金化，形成类似不连续沉淀的独特形貌。
AI.motivation: 熔盐环境能在低于经典脱合金化阈值（5~60 at.%）下产生异常体脱合金化，但对这一反常行为的根本机制尚不清楚，而这一现象对能源系统和电化学应用至关重要。
AI.method: 采用三维重建技术对脱合金区域进行重构，并结合晶体学与元素分析，直接映射三维晶界-孔洞结构，揭示扩散诱导再结晶生成高密度晶界网络的机制。
AI.result: 发现扩散诱导再结晶产生高密度晶界网络，促进熔盐渗透，驱动远低于传统 parting limit 的体脱合金化，形成类似不连续沉淀的独特形貌。
AI.conclusion: 理解晶界-孔洞的动态相互作用对于预测和控制复杂电化学环境中的脱合金化行为至关重要。

title: A differential derivation of the Obara-Saika relation for Gaussian electron repulsion integrals
summary: The Obara-Saika (OS) method is one of the most widely used techniques in quantum chemistry for evaluating electron repulsion integrals (ERIs) via a set of recurrence relations that build higher angular momentum integrals from lower-order ones. The original derivation by Obara and Saika proceeded by directly relating integrals of differing angular momentum. In this work, we present a compact novel derivation of the OS vertical recurrence relation based solely on differential relations between Gaussian basis functions, expanding on a method suggested in earlier work. By explicitly deriving the required derivative expressions we identify all non-zero primitive terms contributing to the full ERI to develop a hierarchical formulation of the OS recursion relations. This approach has pedagogical value as a rigorous and self-contained derivation. Additionally, the resulting organization exposes independent primitive derivative quantities and may be useful for code generation and parallel implementations on modern GPU architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Obara-Saika垂直递推关系的一种全新推导方法，仅基于高斯基函数的微分关系，具有教学价值，并可能有利于GPU上的代码生成和并行实现。
AI.motivation: OS方法是量子化学中计算电子排斥积分最广泛使用的技术之一，但其原始推导较为复杂。作者希望提供一种更简洁、自洽的推导方式，同时揭示原始项的结构以便于并行计算。
AI.method: 作者仅利用高斯基函数之间的微分关系，显式推导出所需导数表达式，识别出所有非零原始项，从而构建OS递推关系的层次化形式。
AI.result: 成功推导出OS垂直递推关系的紧凑新形式，识别了所有非零原始导数项，形成了层次化结构。
AI.conclusion: 该推导具有教学上的严谨性和自洽性；同时暴露了独立的原始导数量，对现代GPU架构上的代码自动生成和并行实现有潜在价值。

title: A Scoping Review of Physics Informed Machine Learning for Wave Propagation Modeling in Seismology
summary: \emph{Background:} Standard numerical methods accurately simulate seismic waves but are computationally expensive, particularly for inverse problems. Machine learning approaches have been proposed as alternatives that can reduce computational cost while maintaining acceptable physical accuracy. \emph{Objective:} To map how physics-informed machine learning methods have been applied to seismic wave propagation modeling based on partial differential equations. \emph{Methods:} A scoping review was conducted using the OpenAlex and Scopus databases. Selected studies were classified by problem type (forward or inverse) and machine learning strategy to identify research trends, methodological patterns, and gaps in the literature. \emph{Results:} Physics-informed machine learning has been applied to both forward modeling and inversion in seismology, often reaching accuracy comparable to standard numerical methods at lower computational cost. Application of three mechanisms for incorporating physical knowledge were identified: observational bias, inductive bias, and learning bias. To evaluate methodological reproducibility of a representative method, the original PINN framework was replicated in PyTorch, obtaining results consistent with and in most cases more accurate than those originally reported. From the reviewed literature, limitations remain in benchmarking consistency, training cost, and scalability to three-dimensional and experimentally validated problems. \emph{Conclusions:} Standard numerical methods remain the basis of seismological workflows, while physics-informed machine learning offers complementary approaches that are useful for inverse problems and surrogate modeling. Future work should focus on consistent benchmarking, hybrid formulations, and validation under realistic geophysical conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文通过范围综述，系统梳理了物理信息机器学习在地震波传播建模中的应用，发现其在正演和反演问题中能达到与标准数值方法相当的精度且计算成本更低，但仍存在基准测试一致性、训练成本和三维可扩展性等挑战。
AI.motivation: 标准数值方法模拟地震波计算成本高昂，尤其在反问题中；机器学习被视为降低计算成本同时保持物理精度的替代方案。本文旨在绘制物理信息机器学习方法在地震波传播建模中的应用图谱。
AI.method: 使用OpenAlex和Scopus数据库进行范围综述，按问题类型（正演/反演）和机器学习策略分类，并复现了原始PINN框架以评估方法可重复性。
AI.result: 物理信息机器学习在地震学正演和反演中均达到接近标准方法的精度且成本更低；识别了三种物理知识融入机制（观测偏置、归纳偏置、学习偏置）；复现实验获得比原始报告更准确的结果；发现基准测试一致性、训练成本和三维可扩展性方面的局限。
AI.conclusion: 标准数值方法仍是地震学工作流的基础，物理信息机器学习作为互补手段在反问题和代理建模中具有价值。未来应聚焦于一致基准测试、混合公式和真实地球物理条件下的验证。

title: Dissipation splits the Mott transition in one dimension
summary: Understanding how dissipation modifies quantum phase transitions is a central challenge in many-body physics. A paradigmatic example is the one-dimensional Mott transition, which in isolated systems separates a conducting Luttinger liquid (LL) from a Mott insulator (MI). Here, we study the fate of this transition in the presence of dissipative baths locally coupled to the density. Using bosonisation and an exact integration of the bath degrees of freedom, we show that dissipation fundamentally reshapes the phase diagram for bath exponents $s<3/2$, where $s$ characterises the low-energy bath spectrum. Rather than undergoing a direct LL-MI transition, the system develops an intermediate dissipative phase (DP) that is compressible and gapless, yet has zero superfluid stiffness. As a result, the conventional Mott transition splits into two distinct critical phenomena: a Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless transition from the LL to the DP, followed by a new commensurate-incommensurate transition from the DP to the MI. We derive an effective field theory for the latter transition and characterize its universality. For $1<s<3/2$, the critical exponents vary continuously with the bath exponent as $β=ν=1/z=s-1$, while for $s<1$ the transition is governed by $β=ν=1/z=0$ and the doping vanishes sharper than any power law. State-of-the-art Monte Carlo simulations quantitatively support our predictions. These results demonstrate that dissipation can qualitatively alter the nature of the Mott transition and generate novel critical behaviour in strongly correlated one-dimensional systems.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一维Mott相变在耗散环境下的行为，发现耗散会从根本上改变相图：系统不再经历从Luttinger液体到Mott绝缘体的直接跃迁，而是中间出现一个新的耗散相（DP）。这导致传统Mott相变分裂为两个不同临界现象：先是BKT转变（LL到DP），再是新的公度-非公度转变（DP到MI）。对于不同耗散指数，临界指数呈现连续变化或奇异行为。
AI.motivation: 理解耗散如何改变量子相变是多体物理的核心挑战之一，本文以1D Mott相变为范例，研究局域密度耗散对其的影响。
AI.method: 使用玻色化方法和浴自由度的精确积分，结合最先进的蒙特卡洛模拟。
AI.result: 发现了耗散诱导的新中间相（DP），压缩性非零且无能隙，但超流刚度为0。Mott相变分裂为两个转变，临界指数随耗散指数连续变化（β=ν=1/z=s-1，当1<s<3/2），或出现更奇异的掺杂行为（s<1时）。
AI.conclusion: 耗散可以定性改变Mott相变的性质，在强关联一维系统中产生新颖的临界行为。

title: Slow heat-driven flow in a gas of hard disks
summary: We study a slow heat-driven flow in a gas of elastically colliding hard disks confined to a long channel. The initial state consists of two regions with large temperature and density contrasts but nearly equal pressures, leading to a low-Mach-number, nearly isobaric evolution. In the dilute limit, the corresponding isobaric hydrodynamic theory reduces to a previously known ideal-gas description. We extend this theory to finite densities by incorporating a non-ideal equation of state of a hard-disk fluid, and solve the resulting one-dimensional equations numerically. Finite-density effects produce appreciable deviations from the ideal-gas prediction. We then test the theory directly against event-driven molecular dynamics simulations of hard disks and find very good agreement in both the dilute and finite-density regimes. The results provide, to our knowledge, the first particle-level test of isobaric gas dynamics of a strongly inhomogeneous cooling flow.

AI.tldr: 本文通过硬球分子动力学模拟，研究了受限通道中硬球气体的慢速热驱动流，发现非理想状态方程在高密度下显著偏离理想气体预测，并首次通过粒子级模拟验证了强非均匀冷却流的等压气体动力学理论。
AI.motivation: 现有等压气体动力学理论主要基于理想气体假设，缺乏高密度非理想气体区域以及强非均匀冷却流的粒子级验证，作者希望弥补这一空白。
AI.method: 采用事件驱动分子动力学模拟硬球系统，结合非理想硬球流体的状态方程推导有限密度等压流体力学理论，并将一维数值解与模拟结果直接对比。
AI.result: 有限密度效应导致与理想气体预测的显著偏差；理论计算与硬球分子动力学模拟在稀薄和高密度区域均吻合良好。
AI.conclusion: 首次提供了强非均匀冷却流等压气体动力学的粒子级验证，证明了非理想状态方程在高密度情况下的必要性。

title: Surface Platinum Alloying for Passivation of Oxide Interfaces on Superconducting Niobium Films
summary: Dielectric loss arising from two-level systems (TLS) at surfaces and interfaces remains a primary limitation to coherence in superconducting transmon qubits. Niobium (Nb), a widely used material in superconducting quantum circuits, readily forms native oxides under ambient conditions, leading to lossy dielectric interfaces that degrade device performance. Here, a robust and scalable fabrication strategy is demonstrated for chemically stabilizing Nb surfaces and mitigating further oxidation, including protection of both surface and sidewall regions. High-purity Nb films were fabricated with bulk-like superconducting transition temperatures ($T_c = 9.30\pm0.10$) K. We demonstrate that a thin Pt encapsulation layer, deposited after native oxide formation, can be transformed via thermal annealing into a Nb-Pt alloy at the surface. Spectroscopic and microscopic analyses confirm the formation of a chemically stable metallic alloy layer and its ability to suppress further oxide growth. Ab initio simulations elucidate the atomic-scale rearrangement and electronic structure evolution associated with Pt incorporation on native niobium oxide, providing insight into the stabilization mechanism of the alloyed surface. This approach offers a materials pathway for engineering chemically robust Nb interfaces, including sidewalls, toward higher-coherence superconducting qubit architectures."

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用Nb-Pt合金化表面钝化策略，通过热退火将Pt封装层转化为稳定合金，抑制铌（Nb）表面及侧壁的进一步氧化，从而降低超导量子比特中因两能级系统（TLS）引起的介电损耗，提升器件相干性。
AI.motivation: 超导transmon量子比特的相干性受限于表面/界面两能级系统（TLS）引起的介电损耗，而铌（Nb）易在空气中形成原生氧化物，产生有损介电界面，亟待开发可规模化、鲁棒的化学稳定化策略。
AI.method: 制备高纯度Nb薄膜，沉积Pt封装层后通过热退火形成Nb-Pt合金；结合光谱学与显微学表征验证合金层的化学稳定性及抑制氧化效果；利用第一性原理模拟揭示Pt掺入原生氧化铌后的原子尺度重排与电子结构演化机制。
AI.result: 实现了体材料级超导转变温度（Tc=9.30±0.10 K）的高纯Nb薄膜；证实Nb-Pt合金层能有效抑制进一步氧化；模拟结果阐明了合金化表面的稳定化机制。
AI.conclusion: 该Nb-Pt合金化策略提供了一种可扩展的材料路径，用于工程化化学鲁棒的Nb界面（包括侧壁），有望推动更高相干性的超导量子比特架构发展。

title: An analog ac voltage amplifier based on a single straintronic magnetic tunnel junction
summary: Magnetic tunnel junctions (MTJs) are known for their digital applications (memory and logic). A special class of them called "straintronic" magnetic tunnel junctions (s-MTJ) has lately emerged as a potential platform for analog applications because their conductance can be varied continuously with mechanical strain generated with a gate voltage. The conductance versus gate voltage (transfer) characteristic always has a linear region and that can be leveraged for a variety of analog applications. Here, we discuss one such application, namely analog voltage amplification. If the s-MTJ's gate voltage is fixed around the midpoint of the linear region and a small ac voltage is superimposed on it, then the ac voltage can be amplified without distortion as long as its amplitude is small enough to avoid gate voltage excursion beyond the linear region. Unlike a transistor-based voltage amplifier whose amplification is determined solely by the transistor's internal parameters - namely the transconductance and Early resistance - here the amplification can be varied by an external power supply voltage. We examine the maximum allowed amplitude and frequency of input signal for distortion-free amplification by modeling the magnetization dynamics and derive an expression for the amplification.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了"应变磁隧道结"(s-MTJ)在模拟电压放大中的应用，利用其线性区的电导-电压特性实现可调增益的电压放大。
AI.motivation: 传统MTJ主要用于数字领域，而s-MTJ具有连续可调电导特性，研究者希望探索其在模拟电路中的应用潜力，特别是电压放大。
AI.method: 将s-MTJ的栅极电压偏置在线性区中点，叠加小幅度交流电压，通过磁化动力学建模分析最大允许输入幅度和频率，推导放大倍数表达式。
AI.result: s-MTJ可实现无失真的电压放大，与晶体管放大器不同，其增益可通过外部电源电压调节。
AI.conclusion: s-MTJ作为新型模拟放大器件具有独特优势（增益可调），但需控制输入信号幅度和频率以避免超出线性区导致失真。

title: Modulation of the Nernst Thermoelectrics by Regulating the Anomalous Hall and Nernst Angles
summary: The large anomalous Nernst effect in magnetic Weyl semimetals is one of the most intriguing transport phenomena, which draws significant attention for its potential applications in topological thermoelectrics. Despite frequent reports of substantial anomalous Nernst conductivity (ANC), methods to optimize Nernst thermoelectrics remain limited. Our research reveals that the magnitude of the ANC is directly related to the sum of the anomalous Nernst and Hall angles. While the sign of the anomalous Hall angle is relatively stable in a certain material, the sign of the anomalous Nernst angle can be intrinsically tuned. Therefore, the ANC can be effectively optimized by regulating these angles to work in concert. This finding is verified by experimental modulation from iron-doped magnetic topological material Co3Sn2S2. Additionally, we observed a robust TlnT scaling law of the ANC over the temperature range of 40 to 140 K in all studied samples, suggesting an intrinsic origin of the ANC. Considering the common opposite sign of the anomalous Nernst and Hall angles in many magnetic topological materials, our research offers an applicable scheme for optimizing the Nernst thermoelectrics.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了反常能斯特电导率(ANC)的幅值与反常能斯特角与反常霍尔角之和成正比，通过调控两者符号一致可有效优化ANC，并在磁性拓扑材料Co3Sn2S2中通过铁掺杂实验验证，同时发现ANC在40-140K内遵循TlnT标度律，为优化拓扑热电材料提供了新方案。
AI.motivation: 尽管磁性Weyl半金属中巨大的反常能斯特效应备受关注且有潜在应用价值，但优化能斯特热电性能的方法仍然有限，亟需探索有效的调控策略。
AI.method: 理论上推导出ANC与反常能斯特角及反常霍尔角之和的直接关系；实验上通过对铁掺杂的磁性拓扑材料Co3Sn2S2进行调控，验证了该优化策略的有效性。
AI.result: ANC幅值取决于反常能斯特角与反常霍尔角之和；通过铁掺杂可调节反常能斯特角符号，使两角协同一致从而优化ANC；在40-140K范围内ANC呈现TlnT标度律。
AI.conclusion: 利用反常能斯特角与反常霍尔角的符号可调性，提出了一种适用于多种磁性拓扑材料的能斯特热电优化方案，具有普适性和应用前景。

title: Irreducible Representations as Multireference Indicators for Diradicaloid Systems
summary: Multireference behavior in molecules often arises when a small gap between frontier orbitals results in mixing of closed and open-shell configurations. Standard multireference diagnostics of this regime usually rely on correlated wavefunctions, natural-orbital occupations, or reduced density matrices. Here, we examine a complementary, symmetry-based criterion for a model system. For a time-reversal-invariant Hamiltonian, a symmetry-preserving, closed-shell Slater determinant must transform as the trivial irreducible representation of its point group. Therefore, a nontrivial, many-electron irreducible representation excludes such a description. We compare two pathways within the same model to demonstrate this. Along the control pathway, the frontier orbitals remain separated and the ground state retains a trivial irreducible representation over the weak-to-intermediate interaction regime. Along the obstructed pathway, a high-symmetry point produces a frontier-orbital degeneracy, resulting in a singlet ground state with two-configuration character and a nontrivial irreducible representation. Exact diagonalization, a two-state effective model, and the Frobenius norm of the two-particle cumulant provide a consistent picture in this regime, demonstrating that irreducible representations can serve as a low-cost diagnostic of multireference character in diradicaloid models. While symmetry is not a quantitative measure of correlation strength, it does offer a computationally inexpensive screening tool to identify obstructions to a single-reference description.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了一种基于对称性的多参考特征诊断方法：当分子基态的非平凡不可约表示排除了单参考闭壳层描述时，即表明存在多参考特征。通过模型体系的两条路径对比，验证了不可约表示可作为低成本筛选工具来识别多参考特征。
AI.motivation: 传统多参考诊断依赖关联波函数、自然轨道占据数或约化密度矩阵，计算成本较高。本文旨在探索一种基于对称性的互补诊断标准，为识别多参考特征提供低成本的筛选工具。
AI.method: 通过一个模型体系的两条路径（控制路径与阻塞路径）进行对比分析。采用精确对角化、两态有效模型以及双粒子累积量的Frobenius范数等方法，研究不可约表示与多参考特征之间的关系。
AI.result: 控制路径中，前线轨道保持分离，基态保持平凡不可约表示，呈现弱到中等相互作用；阻塞路径中，高对称点导致前线轨道简并，产生双组态特征的单重态基态，其不可约表示为非平凡的。多种方法给出了一致的描述。
AI.conclusion: 不可约表示可作为多参考特征的低成本诊断工具，虽然它不是相关强度的定量度量，但能提供一种计算廉价的筛选手段，用于识别单参考描述受阻的体系。

title: LSR-Net: Long-Short-Range Operator Learning for Pattern Dynamics on Manifolds
summary: We propose the Long-Short-Range Neural Network (LSR-Net), an extensible operator-learning framework for predicting pattern dynamics on planar domains, spherical surfaces, and general manifolds. The method decomposes the forward evolution operator into a long-range component, represented by a compact Fourier multiplier constructed via the Sum-of-Exponentials (SOE) approximation, and a short-range component adapted to the underlying geometry and its intrinsic symmetries. For general manifolds represented by irregularly sampled point clouds, the long-range component is implemented by Gaussian gridding onto an auxiliary regular grid, where the Fourier multiplier is efficiently applied in k-space using FFT and the result is interpolated back to the original sample points. We evaluate LSR-Net on several benchmark systems, including the Allen-Cahn, Cahn-Hilliard, Schnakenberg, and Turing systems, over planar domains, spherical surfaces, and a blob-shaped manifold. Numerical results demonstrate that LSR-Net consistently achieves higher accuracy and improved stability compared with baseline operator-learning models. In particular, for Allen-Cahn dynamics on the sphere, the RMSE is reduced by approximately three orders of magnitude compared with the Spherical Fourier Neural Operator (SFNO). Rotation and reflection equivariance tests further confirm that the learned operator is consistent with these geometric transformations. These results indicate that LSR-Net provides an effective and robust approach for learning pattern dynamics on complex geometries.

AI.tldr: LSR-Net 是一种可扩展的算子学习框架，通过将前向演化算子分解为长程（傅里叶乘子，使用SOE近似）和短程（适应几何结构与对称性）两部分，结合高斯网格化与FFT，在平面域、球面及一般流形上高效预测斑图动力学，精度与稳定性显著优于现有方法（如Allen-Cahn球面动力学RMSE降低约三个数量级）。
AI.motivation: 现有算子学习方法在处理复杂几何（球面、一般流形）上的斑图动力学时，难以同时兼顾长程全局依赖与几何局部对称性，且计算效率有限。因此需要一种可扩展到不同几何结构的高精度、鲁棒的算子学习框架。
AI.method: 将演化算子分解为长程部分（基于SOE近似的紧凑傅里叶乘子，通过FFT高效计算）和短程部分（适应几何与对称性）；对于一般流形（不规则采样点云），采用高斯网格化映射到辅助规则网格，在k空间应用FFT后再插值回原始点云。
AI.result: 在Allen-Cahn、Cahn-Hilliard、Schnakenberg、Turing等基准系统上测试平面域、球面及blob形流形；LSR-Net在所有几何上均取得更高精度与稳定性，球面Allen-Cahn的RMSE比SFNO降低约三个数量级；通过旋转/反射等变测试验证了算子与几何变换的一致性。
AI.conclusion: LSR-Net是一种有效且鲁棒的算子学习框架，适用于复杂几何上的斑图动力学预测，具有出色的精度、稳定性和几何等变性。

title: Phase distinction of Gibbs states without symmetry breaking: topological invariants of the 3D toric code
summary: We study the finite-temperature topological order of the three-dimensional $\mathbb{Z}_2$ toric code in a generic magnetic field, where every higher-form symmetry is explicitly broken and can at most be emergent. We show perturbatively, and confirm by large-scale quantum Monte Carlo, that the topological entanglement entropy stays quantized at $γ= \ln 2$ throughout the topological phase -- at finite temperature and under the symmetry-breaking field alike -- and collapses to $0$ across the thermal transition, a quantization protected geometrically by the Bianchi identity rather than by any exact symmetry of the system. The plateau $γ= \ln 2$ is, however, not invariant under quasi-local channels: a constant-depth channel can generate this identical quantized value from a trivial product state. We therefore introduce the decoded Wilson-loop correlation $f_W$, which quantizes to $1$ in the topological phase and $0$ in the trivial phase as $L\to\infty$ and, unlike $γ$, is a quasi-local-channel invariant -- a robust topological invariant of the mixed state.

AI.tldr: 该论文在3D Z₂拓扑编码模型中，证明即使在高阶对称性破缺和有限温度下，拓扑纠缠熵仍保持γ=ln2的量子化值，并引入一种准局部通道不变的解码Wilson环关联函数f_W作为混合态拓扑不变量。
AI.motivation: 传统拓扑序理论依赖于精确对称性，但实际系统常存在对称性破缺和有限温度效应，因此需要研究在对称性破缺和热扰动下拓扑序的鲁棒性，并寻找超越对称性保护的拓扑不变量。
AI.method: 采用微扰理论和大规模量子蒙特卡洛模拟，分析3D Z₂拓扑编码模型在任意磁场下的有限温度拓扑序；引入解码Wilson环关联函数，检验其在准局部通道下的不变性。
AI.result: 拓扑纠缠熵γ在拓扑相中保持ln2量子化值，在热相变后坍缩为0；但γ并非准局部通道不变，而解码Wilson环关联函数f_W在拓扑相中量子化为1，在平庸相中为0，且是准局部通道不变。
AI.conclusion: 拓扑纠缠熵的量子化由Bianchi恒等式几何保护而非对称性；解码Wilson环关联函数可作为混合态拓扑相变的稳健序参量，其准局部通道不变性使其优于拓扑纠缠熵作为拓扑不变量。

title: Single-cell-level distributions and relationships can differentiate cell-division and growth models
comment: 34 pages, 4+8 Figures, 6 Appendices, some overlap with arXiv:2510.24169
summary: Complex interactions among regulatory molecules determine the rules underlying cell growth and division in microbial cells. While the governing molecular network may not always be obvious, it is well known that correlations among certain physiological quantities measured in experiments, such as birth-size, division-size, division-time, and division-added-size, can differentiate among various cell-division models, such as Timer, Sizer, and Adder. Here we show that, apart from these correlations, which we extend for the case of stochastic single-cell growth and stochastic asymmetric partitioning, probability distributions of these quantities and statistical relationships between them can also be used to differentiate between these division models. Interestingly, we show that these quantities can not only differentiate the division models, but also distinguish among the single-cell growth paradigms, such as linear and exponential growth. We then demonstrate this differentiability among various division and growth models by comparing our analytical results with published experimental data. We further show that these results remain valid even when the growth rate of a cell is correlated with the growth rate of cells from previous generations in the lineage.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析概率分布和统计关系，证明单细胞生长与分裂的随机性数据（如出生大小、分裂大小、分裂时间等）不仅能区分Timer、Sizer、Adder等分裂模型，还能区分线性与指数生长模式，且结果在生长速率代际相关时仍成立。
AI.motivation: 传统研究仅关注生理量之间的相关性来区分细胞分裂模型，作者希望探索概率分布和统计关系是否也能用于区分不同的分裂模型和生长模式，从而提供更强的区分能力。
AI.method: 理论上建立随机单细胞生长和不对称分裂的数学模型，推导出生大小、分裂大小、分裂时间等量的概率分布和统计关系；通过与已发表的实验数据对比验证理论结果；进一步考虑生长速率代际相关性对结论的影响。
AI.result: 发现概率分布和统计关系不仅能区分Timer、Sizer、Adder三种分裂模型，还能区分线性增长和指数增长两种生长模式；与实验数据对比验证了区分能力；即使考虑生长速率代际相关性，结论依然稳健。
AI.conclusion: 概率分布和统计关系是比传统相关性分析更强的区分工具，可用于鉴别细胞分裂模型和单细胞生长模式，在实验数据分析和理论模型验证中有重要应用价值。

title: Quench of chiral superconductivity by quantum phase fluctuations in twisted cuprate bilayers
summary: Following theoretical proposals of chiral $d+id'$ superconductivity in twisted cuprate bilayers, experimental signatures of time-reversal symmetry breaking (TRSB) remain highly controversial. Here we demonstrate that quantum phase fluctuations fundamentally reshape the phase diagram of this proposed chiral state. Unlike regular superconducting orders, the chiral $d+id'$ state requires long-range coherence of an interlayer phase degree of freedom and is therefore intrinsically vulnerable to phase fluctuations. Incorporating these fluctuations nearly eliminates the chiral phase over most parts of the phase diagram, restricting it to a narrow twist-angle window and ultra-low temperatures. The fluctuation-driven destruction of chirality produces a first-order transition into the $d$-wave state, giving rise to coexistence and metastability. Meanwhile, Josephson phase locking is strongly weakened at the TRSB quantum critical point, which sits well within the superconducting regime. More broadly, our work establishes quantum phase fluctuations as a fundamental constraint on the emergence of TRSB phases in low-dimensional layered quantum materials.

AI.tldr: 本文通过量子相位涨落理论，揭示了手性d+id'超导态在扭曲铜氧化物双层中的相图受相位涨落剧烈影响，最终将手性相限制在极窄的扭转角窗口和超低温区间。
AI.motivation: 实验上关于扭曲铜氧化物双层中手性d+id'超导态的时间反演对称性破缺（TRSB）信号存在高度争议，亟需理论解释。
AI.method: 通过引入量子相位涨落机制，分析手性d+id'态中层间相位自由度的长程相干性脆弱性，构建包含相位涨落的相图。
AI.result: 量子相位涨落几乎消灭了大部分相图中的手性相，仅保留极窄扭转角窗口和超低温区域；涨落驱动的手性破坏导致一级相变进入d波态，并产生共存与亚稳态；TRSB量子临界点处的约瑟夫森锁相被严重削弱。
AI.conclusion: 量子相位涨落是低维层状量子材料中TRSB相产生的根本性约束因素。

title: Universal Scaling of the Spin Hall Effect
summary: We study the spin Hall (SH) effect for the Dirac electrons in terms of the spin and magnetic-moment accumulation coefficients $-Γ^{00} g_{s(m)z}^{\phantom{s(m)z} xy}$. We take short-range nonmagnetic impurities into account within the self-consistent $T$-matrix approximation. Similarly to the universal scaling for the anomalous Hall (AH) effect, we find three disctinct regimes by changing the electric conductivity $σ^{yy}$; the superclean regime with $-Γ^{00} g_{s(m)z}^{\phantom{s(m)z} xy} \propto σ^{yy}$ owing to the skew scattering, moderately dirty regime with almost constant $-Γ^{00} g_{s(m)z}^{\phantom{s(m)z} xy}$, and dirty regime with a new scaling relation $-Γ^{00} g_{s(m)z}^{\phantom{s(m)z} xy} \propto (σ^{yy})^{0.6}$ whose exponent differs from that of the AH conductivity. Our results construct a unified theory of the SH effect without any ambiguity of spin current.

AI.tldr: 本文在自洽T矩阵近似下，研究了狄拉克电子的自旋霍尔效应，发现了与反常霍尔效应类似但具有不同指数的三种标度行为，构建了无歧义的自旋霍尔效应统一理论。
AI.motivation: 消除自旋电流定义的歧义，建立自旋霍尔效应的统一理论框架。
AI.method: 采用自洽T矩阵近似处理短程非磁性杂质，通过电导率σ^{yy}的变化，分析自旋和磁矩累积系数-Γ^{00} g_{s(m)z}^{xy}的标度行为。
AI.result: 发现了三个不同区域：超清洁区（-Γ^{00} g_{s(m)z}^{xy} ∝ σ^{yy}，斜散射主导）、中等脏区（几乎恒定）、脏区（-Γ^{00} g_{s(m)z}^{xy} ∝ (σ^{yy})^{0.6}，指数与AH电导率不同）。
AI.conclusion: 构建了自旋霍尔效应的统一理论，揭示了其在不同杂质浓度下的普适标度行为。

title: Atom-selective spin-polarized transport in a charge-ordered altermagnet
summary: Altermagnets provide a promising platform for spin-polarized transport without net magnetization, but their transport properties are usually discussed in terms of momentum-space spin splitting. Here, using first-principles calculations and quantum transport simulations, we show that the charge-ordered altermagnet $α$-Fe$_2$PO$_5$ exhibits a distinct form of real-space spin selectivity despite weak altermagnetic spin splitting near the Fermi level. The charge order creates inequivalent Fe$^{2+}$ and Fe$^{3+}$ sites within each sublattice, while the puckered C-type antiferromagnetic stacking suppresses inter-sublattice transport. As a result, electron and hole doping activate spin-polarized transport predominantly through Fe$^{3+}$- and Fe$^{2+}$-based channels, respectively. These atom-selective channels carry opposite spin polarizations on the two antiferromagnetic sublattices, giving rise to a globally compensated charge current with hidden Néel spin character. We further propose an all-in-one $α$-Fe$_2$PO$_5$ tunnel junction, where matching or mismatching atom-selective conduction channels yields orders-of-magnitude conductance modulation. Our findings establish a real-space design principle for atomically controlled spin functionality and spintronic devices.

AI.tldr: 本文通过第一性原理计算和量子输运模拟，发现电荷有序交替磁体α-Fe₂PO₅在实空间中展现出原子选择性的自旋极化输运特性，尽管其费米能级附近交替磁自旋劈裂很弱。电荷序导致不同价态Fe离子位点，结合褶皱C型反铁磁堆垛，使电子和空穴掺杂分别通过Fe³⁺和Fe²⁺通道产生自旋极化输运，并进一步提出基于此原理的全同隧道结器件。
AI.motivation: 交替磁体虽能实现无净磁化的自旋极化输运，但现有研究多聚焦于动量空间的自旋劈裂，缺乏对实空间自旋选择性的深入探索。本文旨在揭示电荷序交替磁体中实空间原子选择性的自旋输运机制，并探索其器件应用潜力。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理计算（密度泛函理论）结合量子输运模拟方法，系统研究α-Fe₂PO₅的电子结构、自旋极化特性以及输运行为，并设计全同隧道结器件进行验证。
AI.result: 发现电荷序导致Fe²⁺和Fe³⁺不等价位点；电子掺杂通过Fe³⁺通道，空穴掺杂通过Fe²⁺通道产生自旋极化输运；不同子格上携带相反自旋极化，形成具有隐藏Néel自旋特征的全局补偿电荷流；基于原子选择性通道匹配/失配可实现隧道结电导的数量级调制。
AI.conclusion: 本研究建立了实空间原子控制自旋功能性的设计原则，为开发新型自旋电子学器件提供了理论依据，拓展了交替磁体的研究范式从动量空间到实空间。

title: Ai2-Kit: Streamlining AI-Accelerated Ab Initio Workflows for Complex Chemical Systems
comment: 24 pages, 11 figures. Submitted to Chemical Science
summary: Molecular simulations of complex chemical systems, such as catalysis, electrochemistry, and energy storage, often need to capture the interplay of effects such as electronic structure, finite-temperature fluctuations, and electric-field response. Such complexity is difficult to address with traditional ab initio calculations, which are limited by the time and length scales they can reach. AI-accelerated ab initio (AI2) methods use machine learning potentials trained on first-principles data to replace expensive electronic-structure calculations, extending ab initio accuracy to these regimes, but their routine application requires reliable workflows that connect first-principles calculations, model training, molecular dynamics, enhanced sampling, trajectory analysis, and HPC orchestration. Here we present ai2-kit, a software toolkit for developing accessible, reproducible, and extensible AI2 workflows. ai2-kit provides high-semantic-density command-line interfaces and Python APIs for structure and dataset conversion, batch task generation, active-learning screening, job orchestration, and workflow recovery. We demonstrate ai2-kit in four representative applications: active-learning-based machine learning potential construction, free-energy perturbation for redox and acid-base processes, electrochemical machine learning potentials for electrified interfaces, and spectroscopies from machine learning molecular dynamics. ai2-kit also provides AI-agent skills that help users adapt these use cases into customized workflows for their own chemical systems and computational software stacks. Together, ai2-kit helps turn AI2 methods from bespoke computational protocols into reusable and extensible workflows for complex chemical systems, from model construction to property prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了 ai2-kit，一个用于构建可访问、可复现且可扩展的 AI 加速从头算（AI2）工作流的软件工具包，帮助将 AI2 方法从定制化计算协议转变为适用于复杂化学系统的可复用工作流。
AI.motivation: 传统从头算计算方法受限于时间和长度尺度，难以处理催化、电化学、能源存储等复杂化学系统中电子结构、有限温度涨落和电场响应的相互耦合效应。AI 加速的从头算方法虽能扩展精度适用范围，但缺乏可靠的工作流来连接第一性原理计算、模型训练、分子动力学、增强采样、轨迹分析和高性能计算编排等环节。
AI.method: ai2-kit 提供高语义密度的命令行界面和 Python API，支持结构与数据集转换、批量任务生成、主动学习筛选、任务编排和工作流恢复。同时提供 AI-agent 技能帮助用户将示范用例定制为符合自身化学体系和计算软件栈的工作流。
AI.result: 在四个代表性应用中验证了 ai2-kit 的有效性：基于主动学习的机器学习势构建、氧化还原和酸碱过程的自由能微扰、电化学界面机器学习势、以及基于机器学习分子动力学的光谱学。
AI.conclusion: ai2-kit 将 AI2 方法从定制化计算协议转变为可复用、可扩展的工作流，覆盖从模型构建到性质预测的全流程，有助于推动 AI2 方法在复杂化学系统中的常规化应用。

title: Lanczos Method for QRPA Strength Functions in Atomic Nuclei
summary: We present a symmetric Lanczos method for computing charge-changing QRPA strength functions in atomic nuclei. Starting from the finite-amplitude-method formulation of the QRPA linear-response problem, we derive equivalent spectral representations and, in the real case, a reduced eigenvalue problem involving the matrix products $MK$ and $KM$, where $M\equiv A+B$ and $K\equiv A-B$ are formed from the usual QRPA matrices $A$ and $B$. The resulting formulation enables a matrix-free Lanczos approximation of the Lorentzian-smeared strength function over a broad energy interval from a single Krylov run, in contrast to conventional frequency-by-frequency response calculations. Numerical tests for $^{112}$Sn and $^{150}$Nd first show that GMRES reproduces the converged iterative FAM strength profiles while requiring fewer iterations. Using GMRES as the frequency-by-frequency reference, we then show that the Lanczos approximation reproduces the same strength profiles with reduced overall cost. These results indicate that symmetric Lanczos projection provides an efficient and accurate approach for QRPA strength-function calculations when spectral information is required over an extended frequency range.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种对称Lanczos方法，用于计算原子核中电荷交换QRPA强度函数。该方法基于有限振幅法推导出等效谱表示，并通过矩阵乘积MK和KM构建约化特征值问题，实现单次Krylov运行即可获得宽能量范围内的Lorentzian展宽强度函数，相比传统逐频率响应计算更高效。在¹¹²Sn和¹⁵⁰Nd上的数值测试验证了其准确性和效率。
AI.motivation: 传统QRPA强度函数计算需要逐频率求解线性响应问题，计算成本高昂。作者希望开发一种更高效的方法，能够在一次计算中获得宽能量范围内的谱信息。
AI.method: 从有限振幅法（FAM）的QRPA线性响应公式出发，推导出对称Lanczos方法。通过构建矩阵乘积MK和KM，将问题转化为约化特征值问题，实现无需显式存储矩阵的Lanczos近似，在单次Krylov子空间迭代中计算Lorentzian展宽强度函数。
AI.result: 在¹¹²Sn和¹⁵⁰Nd的数值测试中：(1) GMRES方法重现了收敛的迭代FAM强度曲线，且迭代次数更少；(2) 以GMRES为逐频率参考，Lanczos近似在降低总体计算成本的同时复现了相同的强度曲线。
AI.conclusion: 对称Lanczos投影为QRPA强度函数计算提供了一种高效且准确的方法，特别适合需要在宽频率范围内获取谱信息的场景。

title: Holographic Quantum Transformer: A Generalist Neuro-Symbolic Architecture for Solving Frustrated Systems via Generative Attention
summary: Simulating two-dimensional frustrated quantum matter is a grand challenge due to the sign problem and exponential Hilbert space complexity. In this work, we introduce the Holographic Quantum Transformer (HQT), a physics-inspired generative architecture that leverages global self-attention to resolve non-local entanglement patterns. We validate HQT on the square lattice $J_1-J_2$ Heisenberg model. On the heavily frustrated $8 \times 8$ lattice at the quantum critical point ($J_2=0.5$), HQT reaches a ground-state energy per site ($E/N$) of $\mathbf{-0.5001(1)}$, consistent with the expected finite-size scaling trend. Beyond numerical accuracy, HQT exhibits intrinsic physical awareness, autonomously recovering the underlying $J_2$ interaction geometry through interpretable attention maps. Our central contribution is ``Holographic Transfer", a zero-shot size-extrapolation protocol with rapid alignment: a model trained on $8 \times 8$ systems is directly projected onto larger $10 \times 10$ lattices via continuous positional-embedding interpolation and head re-initialization, achieving high-fidelity initialization and rapid convergence. This zero-shot protocol yields an energy of $E/N = \mathbf{-0.49782(3)}$, statistically consistent with the variational state of the art while requiring no from-scratch training on the target lattice. Our results establish generative attention as a scalable paradigm for transferable quantum simulation.

AI.tldr: 提出全息量子变换器（HQT），一种基于生成式自注意力机制的架构，用于模拟受挫量子自旋系统。在$8\times8$ $J_1-J_2$海森堡模型量子临界点达到$E/N=-0.5001(1)$；核心贡献是"全息迁移"零样本尺寸外推协议，可将$8\times8$训练模型直接投影到$10\times10$格点，无需重新训练即可达到$E/N=-0.49782(3)$，与变分方法统计一致。
AI.motivation: 二维受挫量子物质的模拟面临符号问题和指数级希尔伯特空间复杂性的挑战，现有方法（如DMRG、神经网络变分方法）在强受挫区域和大尺寸系统上计算成本高昂，且缺乏跨系统尺寸的可迁移性。
AI.method: 提出HQT架构，核心是全局自注意力机制以解析非局域纠缠模式；引入"全息迁移"协议，通过连续位置嵌入插值和头重新初始化，将小系统上训练的模型零样本投影到大系统上。
AI.result: 在$8\times8$ $J_1-J_2$模型$J_2=0.5$处达到$E/N=-0.5001(1)$，与有限尺寸标度趋势一致；注意力图可解释地恢复$J_2$相互作用几何；零样本迁移到$10\times10$格点达到$E/N=-0.49782(3)$，与变分法最优结果统计一致。
AI.conclusion: 生成式注意力机制为可迁移量子模拟提供了可扩展的新范式，全息迁移协议有望大幅降低大尺寸量子模拟的计算成本。

title: Power-Law Relaxation of Non-Gaussian Parameter and Self-Dynamic Structure Factor in Multidimensional Rugged Energy Landscapes
summary: Ruggedness of the underlying energy landscape gives rise to heterogeneous mobility and non-Gaussian diffusion. We develop a theoretical framework for tagged-particle diffusion in multidimensional rugged energy landscapes modeled as correlated quenched Gaussian random fields. Using the self-propagator and self-dynamic structure factor, we characterize finite-time diffusion beyond the effective diffusion coefficient. We determine the effects of dimensionality, spatial correlations, and initial preparation. By introducing a coarse-grained mobility field and a mobility-memory approximation, we relate the non-Gaussian parameter to the time correlation of the mobility sampled by the particle. In the homogenized diffusive regime, the mobility correlation decays algebraically, leading to long-time relaxation of the non-Gaussian parameter as $t^{-1/2}$ in one dimension, $(\ln t)/t$ in two dimensions, and $t^{-1}$ for $d>2$, with amplitudes that depend on dimensionality and the initial ensemble. Our results show that rugged energy landscapes leave distinct signatures in the effective diffusion coefficient, self-dynamic structure factor, and relaxation of non-Gaussian fluctuations.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了一个理论框架，用于描述在多维崎岖能量景观（由相关淬火高斯随机场建模）中标记粒子的扩散行为，发现非高斯参数在不同维度下呈现不同的幂律衰减行为（1D: t^{-1/2}, 2D: (ln t)/t, d>2: t^{-1}），并揭示了空间相关性、维度及初始准备对扩散的影响。
AI.motivation: 崎岖能量景观导致异质迁移和非高斯扩散，现有研究多集中于有效扩散系数，缺乏对有限时间扩散行为、非高斯涨落及其维度依赖性的系统理论描述。
AI.method: 利用自传播子和自动态结构因子表征有限时间扩散；引入粗粒度迁移率场和迁移率-记忆近似，将非高斯参数与粒子采样的迁移率时间关联联系起来。
AI.result: 在均匀化扩散区域，迁移率关联呈代数衰减，导致非高斯参数的维度依赖衰减：1D为t^{-1/2}，2D为(ln t)/t，d>2为t^{-1}，且振幅依赖于维度和初始系综。
AI.conclusion: 崎岖能量景观在有效扩散系数、自动态结构因子和非高斯涨落弛豫中留下独特特征，为理解复杂介质中的异常扩散提供了理论依据。

title: Collective phase modes in twisted $d$-wave superconducting bilayers
summary: Twisted cuprate bilayers have been predicted to host high-temperature chiral $d+id'$ superconductivity, originating from higher-order Josephson coupling processes. In such two-dimensional superconducting systems, long-wavelength fluctuations in the phase of the superconducting order parameter constitute gapless collective modes and therefore remain significant even at zero temperature. Here, we perform a theoretical analysis of the low-energy phase fluctuations in twisted $d$-wave superconducting bilayers, systematically retaining Josephson coupling to all orders. We demonstrate that higher-order Josephson coupling processes lead to nontrivial modifications of the phase dynamics. In particular, the stiffness of the relative phase between the two layers is finite even in the normal state, which is a direct consequence of the intralayer U(1) symmetry breaking explicitly induced by interlayer tunneling. Phase fluctuations suppress the relative-phase stiffness but enhance the overall-phase stiffness in the $d+id'$ phase. Furthermore, the relative-phase fluctuations acquire a small but finite excitation gap, which is no longer equal to the Josephson plasma frequency and is strongly suppressed upon approaching the chiral quantum critical point, indicating the breakdown of Josephson phase locking within the superconducting state.

AI.tldr: 本文理论分析了扭曲铜酸盐双层中d+id'超导相的相位涨落，发现高阶约瑟夫森耦合显著改变了相位动力学：相对相位在正常态下就具有有限刚度，d+id'相中相位涨落会抑制相对相位刚度但增强整体相位刚度，且相对相位涨落存在一个小的激发隙，该隙在趋近手性量子临界点时被强烈压制，表明超导态内约瑟夫森相位锁定被破坏。
AI.motivation: 在扭曲铜酸盐双层结构中，理论预测存在高温手性d+id'超导，但长波相位涨落作为无能隙集体模式即使在零温下也至关重要，因此需要系统分析低能相位涨落的动力学行为。
AI.method: 对扭曲d波超导双层进行理论分析，系统地保留所有阶数的约瑟夫森耦合，研究低能相位涨落。
AI.result: 高阶约瑟夫森耦合导致相位动力学的非平庸修正：正常态下相对相位刚度有限；d+id'相中相位涨落抑制相对刚度但增强整体刚度；相对相位涨落存在有限小激发隙，该隙不等于约瑟夫森等离子体频率，并在趋近手性量子临界点时被强烈压制。
AI.conclusion: 高阶约瑟夫森耦合过程对扭曲d波超导双层中的相位动力学有重要影响，导致约瑟夫森相位锁定在超导态内被破坏。

title: Modulation of anomalous Hall angle in a magnetic topological semimetal
summary: The anomalous Hall angle (θA) is a measure of the efficiency of converting a longitudinal driving current to a transverse spin-polarized Hall current. For anomalous Hall sensing, a large anomalous Hall angle can improve the sensitivity of magnetic field detection. However, modulation of this angle is challenging and magnetic materials typically have low angles of 0.1 to 3°. Here, we report modulation of the anomalous Hall angle in the magnetic Weyl semimetal Co3Sn2S2. We propose that the angle parameter tanθA can be formulated as a function of the product of electrical resistivity and anomalous Hall conductivity. Our scheme was utilized to demonstrate the modulation of tanθA up to a magnitude of 0.46, corresponding to an angle of around 25°. Microfabricated anomalous Hall devices using Fe-doped Co3Sn2S2 single-crystalline nanoflakes exhibit a high Hall sensitivity of 7028 μΩucm/T and a magnetic field detectability of 23.5 nT/Hz0.5 at 1 Hz.

AI.tldr: 本文报道了在磁性Weyl半金属Co3Sn2S2中实现反常霍尔角（θA）的大幅调控，提出tanθA可表示为电阻率与反常霍尔电导率乘积的函数，实验上实现了约25°（tanθA=0.46）的反常霍尔角，并基于Fe掺杂Co3Sn2S2单晶纳米片制备的微型器件获得了7028 μΩucm/T的高霍尔灵敏度与23.5 nT/Hz^0.5的磁场探测极限。
AI.motivation: 反常霍尔角是衡量纵向驱动电流转化为横向自旋极化霍尔电流效率的关键参数，对反常霍尔传感中的磁场检测灵敏度至关重要。然而，该角度的调控极具挑战性，且常规磁性材料的反常霍尔角通常很低（0.1~3°），因此亟需探索有效调控方法以提升器件性能。
AI.method: 提出tanθA = ρxx·σxy（电阻率与反常霍尔电导率乘积）的理论公式；利用磁性Weyl半金属Co3Sn2S2作为材料平台，通过Fe掺杂调控其电子结构，并结合微纳加工技术制备单晶纳米片器件，进行反常霍尔效应的实验测量与性能表征。
AI.result: 成功将反常霍尔角调控至约25°（tanθA=0.46），相比传统磁性材料（0.1~3°）提升了一个数量级；Fe掺杂Co3Sn2S2器件实现了7028 μΩucm/T的高霍尔灵敏度以及23.5 nT/Hz^0.5（1 Hz）的低频磁场探测极限。
AI.conclusion: 通过材料选择（Weyl半金属）与参数公式指导，可实现对反常霍尔角的大幅调控，为高灵敏度磁传感应用提供了新的材料与器件设计思路。

title: Effect of granules anisotropy on "double quantum" magnetic resonance excitation in nanogranular composites
summary: Films of metal-insulator nanogranular composites (CoFeB)x(Al2O3)100-x with different contents of the metal ferromagnetic (FM) phase CoFeB (x ~ 15-50 at.%) are investigated by the method of electron spin resonance (ESR) in a wide range of frequencies (f = 7-80 GHz) and temperatures (T = 4.2-300 K). Besides the conventional FM resonance signal, the experimental spectra demonstrate an additional absorption peak with a double effective g-factor g ~ 4 which is explained within the quantum mechanical "giant spin" model by excitation of "double quantum" transitions in FM granules CoFeB. According to the theory, the intensity of this "double quantum" peak is a complex function of frequency and temperature, including as parameters the granule magnetic moment and anisotropy. Experimentally, the size and anisotropy of the granules can be varied either changing the nominal FM phase content x in the composites or annealing the samples at different temperatures. Here we study the effects of concentration x and thermal annealing of (CoFeB)x(Al2O3)100-x films on their ESR spectral parameters. The observed behavior of the "double quantum" peak intensity is well explained within the considered "giant spin" theoretical concept. In conclusion, we demonstrate the correlation between the size of FM granules in nanocomposites and their anisotropy, indicating the surface origin of this anisotropy.

AI.tldr: 本文利用电子自旋共振（ESR）技术研究了(CoFeB)x(Al2O3)100-x纳米颗粒复合薄膜，发现除常规铁磁共振信号外，还存在一个有效g因子约为4的额外吸收峰，该峰被解释为CoFeB铁磁颗粒中"双量子"跃迁的激发，且其强度与频率、温度、颗粒磁矩及各向异性相关。实验通过改变CoFeB含量x和退火温度调控颗粒尺寸与各向异性，结果与"巨自旋"理论模型吻合，并揭示了颗粒尺寸与各向异性之间的相关性，表明各向异性起源于表面效应。
AI.motivation: 研究金属-绝缘体纳米颗粒复合薄膜中铁磁颗粒的尺寸与各向异性对ESR谱的影响，并通过"巨自旋"理论模型解释"双量子"吸收峰的起源与行为。
AI.method: 采用电子自旋共振（ESR）方法，在7-80 GHz频率和4.2-300 K温度范围内测量(CoFeB)x(Al2O3)100-x薄膜，通过改变CoFeB含量x（15-50 at.%）和退火温度调控颗粒尺寸与各向异性，分析ESR谱中"双量子"峰（g~4）的强度变化。
AI.result: 实验观察到除常规铁磁共振信号外的"双量子"吸收峰（g~4），其强度随频率、温度、CoFeB含量及退火温度变化，且与"巨自旋"模型的理论预测一致。颗粒尺寸与各向异性之间存在相关性，支持各向异性起源于表面效应的结论。
AI.conclusion: "双量子"吸收峰可用"巨自旋"模型中的"双量子"跃迁解释；复合薄膜中铁磁颗粒的各向异性主要来源于表面效应，且与颗粒尺寸密切相关。

title: Inelastic electron scattering induced quantum coherence: isotope effect
summary: Recent discoveries of electron-induced coherence in both resonant and non-resonant interactions have introduced new perspectives in the field. In non-resonant processes, coherence has been observed in dipolar dissociation, where electron-induced excitation forms a coherent superposition of states of opposite parities, resulting in asymmetry in the angle-differential cross-section of the process relative to the incident electron beam. Notably, an isotope effect has been observed in $D_2$ at 50 eV, where heavier isotopes exhibit diminished asymmetry due to their longer dissociation times. Here, we report the isotope effect on quantum coherence in $D_2$ across different electron energies. Additionally, we investigate the role of coherence in the isotopologue HD. Our findings reveal that the asymmetric masses in HD do not influence electron-impact excitation, leading to similar asymmetry in the angular distributions of $H^-$ and $D^-$ ions. This observation is explained by the homonuclear-like behavior of HD within the Franck-Condon region.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了电子诱导相干性中的同位素效应，发现D₂中重同位素因解离时间更长而表现出更弱的角不对称性，并揭示了HD分子在Franck-Condon区内呈类同核行为，其H⁻和D⁻离子角分布不对称性相似。
AI.motivation: 探索电子诱导相干性中的同位素效应，特别是D₂在不同电子能量下的量子相干性，以及HD分子中不对称质量对电子碰撞激发的影响。
AI.method: 通过实验测量电子与D₂和HD分子相互作用的角微分截面，分析H⁻和D⁻离子的角度分布不对称性，比较不同同位素和不同电子能量下的相干性表现。
AI.result: D₂中重同位素（如D₂）表现出更弱的角不对称性；HD中H⁻和D⁻离子的角分布不对称性相似，未受到不对称质量的影响。
AI.conclusion: HD分子在Franck-Condon区内表现出类同核行为，因此其不对称质量不影响电子碰撞激发产生的相干性，解释了H⁻和D⁻离子角分布不对称性相似的现象。

title: Verification of a sequential thermo-poroelasticity formulation in PFLOTRAN
summary: We present the verification of a thermo--hydrologic--mechanical capability implemented within the PFLOTRAN framework, with emphasis on benchmark-based assessment of the THM implementation. The thermal--hydrologic (TH) equations for mass and energy balance are solved on control-volume blocks or Voronoi cells, while the quasi-static momentum balance is solved on an element-based dual mesh. The coupling is achieved using a strictly sequential, non-iterative fixed-stress split strategy in which the TH system is solved implicitly for pressure and temperature, followed by a mechanics update for the displacement unknowns. Several verification problems are set up against poroelastic and thermo-poroelastic benchmarks, demonstrating agreement with analytical or semi-analytical benchmark responses for pressure diffusion, the temperature field, and mechanical deformation. In addition, we propose a treatment for discontinuities (e.g., fractures) based on mapping between mechanical and flow degrees of freedom, and validate the approach by comparison to an analytical solution. This work establishes the basis for thermo-poroelastic coupling in PFLOTRAN and provides a solid modeling foundation for a range of applications (e.g., enhanced geothermal systems and other subsurface energy storage) involving coupled thermal--hydrologic--mechanical (THM) processes in geologic porous media.

AI.tldr: 本文在PFLOTRAN框架内实现并验证了热-水-力学(THM)耦合能力，采用固定应力分裂的序贯求解策略，通过多基准测试验证了与解析/半解析解的一致性，并提出了处理裂缝等不连续面的映射方法。
AI.motivation: 为PFLOTRAN框架建立热-孔隙弹性耦合的数值能力，以满足增强型地热系统(EGS)和地下储能等应用中涉及THM耦合过程的需求。
AI.method: 采用控制体积块或Voronoi网格求解TH方程（质量与能量平衡），在单元双网格上求解准静态动量平衡；通过严格序贯、非迭代的固定应力分裂策略耦合，先隐式求解TH系统得到压力和温度，再更新力学位移；对裂缝等不连续面采用机械与流动自由度映射处理。
AI.result: 针对孔隙弹性与热-孔隙弹性基准问题，在压力扩散、温度场和力学变形方面均与解析或半解析解吻合；裂缝处理方法通过与解析解对比得到验证。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为PFLOTRAN提供了热-孔隙弹性耦合的基础能力，为涉及THM耦合过程的地质多孔介质应用（如增强型地热系统和地下储能）奠定了坚实的建模基础。

title: Weak Ferromagnetism in NiS$_2$ under Nanocrystallization
summary: Structurally well-ordered NiS$_2$ nanocrystals with an average diameter of $27.0 \pm 6.5$ nm retain the bulk-like two-step antiferromagnetic transitions, as shown by magnetization and heat-capacity measurements. Below the lower transition, the nanocrystals exhibit a hysteretic ferromagnetic response with large coercivity, exchange bias, and a vertical loop shift after field cooling, whereas the $M$-$H$ response just above the transition is nearly linear. These features are best explained by uncompensated surface moments generated where the low-temperature antiferromagnetic order terminates at the nanocrystal surface. The absence of a clear additional bulk-like weak-ferromagnetic component constrains homogeneous-canting models and indirectly favors a domain-wall scenario for the weak ferromagnetism of bulk NiS$_2$.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文研究了直径约27 nm的NiS₂纳米晶体，发现其保持了类似块材的两步反铁磁转变，但在低温下表现出铁磁滞后行为（大矫顽力、交换偏置和垂直回线位移），这归因于纳米晶表面的未补偿磁矩。研究还排除了均匀倾斜模型，支持了块材NiS₂弱铁磁性的畴壁机制。
AI.motivation: 作者希望通过研究NiS₂纳米晶体的磁学行为，揭示表面未补偿磁矩对反铁磁纳米材料磁性的影响，并利用纳米尺度的约束效应来区分块材NiS₂弱铁磁性的两种竞争机制（均匀自旋倾斜模型与畴壁模型）。
AI.method: 合成了平均直径27.0 ± 6.5 nm的NiS₂纳米晶体，使用磁化强度和比热测量表征其磁学性质，通过分析M-H回线、矫顽力、交换偏置和垂直回线位移等特征来研究表面效应。
AI.result: 纳米晶体保持了块材的两步反铁磁转变，但在低温下表现出铁磁滞后行为，包括大矫顽力、交换偏置和场冷后的垂直回线位移；未观察到明显的类块材弱铁磁成分。
AI.conclusion: NiS₂纳米晶体的铁磁信号来源于低温反铁磁序在表面终止产生的未补偿表面磁矩；实验排除了均匀自旋倾斜模型，间接支持了畴壁模型作为块材NiS₂弱铁磁性的起源。

title: Phase diagram of a double-occupancy cell model of a fluid with Curie-Weiss interaction
summary: A double-occupancy cell model of a fluid with Curie-Weiss interaction is studied. First, we show that the model is isomorphic to the Blume-Capel model on a complete graph through a simple transformation from spin to occupancy variables. We then investigate its phase behavior within the grand-canonical ensemble using a combination of analytical and numerical methods. Despite its simplicity, the model exhibits a remarkably rich thermodynamic behavior depending on the ratio between the local repulsive and global attractive interactions. We identify regimes characterized by a single critical point, two distinct critical points, tricritical behavior, and triple-point formation. For sufficiently strong repulsion, the system possesses three fluid phases of different densities, leading to both gas-liquid and liquid-liquid coexistence. The locations of the critical, tricritical, and triple points are determined, and the corresponding phase diagrams are constructed. These results demonstrate that the competition between double-occupancy repulsion and long-range attraction is sufficient to generate complex phase behavior in a minimal multiple-occupancy lattice-gas model.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一个具有Curie-Weiss相互作用的双占据元胞流体模型，发现其等价于完全图上的Blume-Capel模型。通过分析局部排斥与全局吸引的竞争，观察到单临界点、双临界点、三临界行为和三相点等多种丰富相行为，并构建了相应相图。
AI.motivation: 探索双占据排斥与长程吸引之间的竞争如何影响多占据格子气模型的相行为，揭示最小模型能否产生复杂的相图特征。
AI.method: 通过自旋到占据数的简单变换证明模型与完全图Blume-Capel模型同构；结合解析与数值方法研究巨正则系综下的相行为。
AI.result: 发现模型存在单临界点、双临界点、三临界行为及三相点等多种相态；对于足够强的排斥作用，系统出现三个不同密度的流体相，包括气-液和液-液共存。
AI.conclusion: 双占据排斥与长程吸引的竞争足以在最小多占据格子气模型中产生复杂的相行为，为理解此类系统的相图提供了理论依据。

title: Resilient $j$=3/2 superconductivity in topological semimetal YPtBi
summary: Cooper pairing in most of the known fermionic superfluids occurs via spin-1/2 quasiparticle interactions that lead to spin-singlet or spin-triplet pairing. In the topological semimetal YPtBi, strong spin-orbit coupling results in a band inversion between highly symmetric $s$- and $p$-like electronic bands and a degeneracy at the $Γ$ point that ensures the manifold of $j$=3/2 quasiparticle states thrive near the Fermi level, where superconducting pairing occurs. Here we study the effects of magnetic and nonmagnetic disorder and carrier density on this exotic superconducting pairing state. By varying levels of disorder and carrier densities by nearly two and three orders of magnitude, respectively, we show that the superconducting critical temperature of YPtBi has a remarkable robustness, with little variation across this span. Our results suggest that superconductivity in YPtBi may reside in a regime where phase stiffness, rather than pair formation, governs the transition temperature. The insensitivity of Cooper pairing to dramatic changes in quasiparticle environment in a $j$=3/2 superconductor highlights a new form of protection realized in topological high-spin superconductors.

AI.tldr: 本文研究拓扑半金属YPtBi中j=3/2准粒子态的超导配对，发现其超导临界温度对无序和载流子密度的巨大变化具有显著鲁棒性，表明其超导可能由相位刚度而非库珀对形成主导，揭示了一种新型拓扑高自旋超导体的保护机制。
AI.motivation: 探索拓扑半金属YPtBi中由强自旋-轨道耦合导致的j=3/2高自旋准粒子态的超导配对特性，以及这种非常规配对对外界扰动的响应。
AI.method: 通过调控磁性和非磁性无序程度（近两个数量级）以及载流子密度（近三个数量级），系统测量YPtBi超导临界温度的变化。
AI.result: 超导临界温度在整个无序和载流子密度变化范围内表现出显著的鲁棒性，几乎无变化。
AI.conclusion: YPtBi的超导可能处于相刚度（而非库珀对形成）决定转变温度的机制；j=3/2超导体中库珀配对对准粒子环境的剧烈变化不敏感，体现出拓扑高自旋超导体中的新型保护机制。

title: Real-time dynamics of triplet-resonant tunneling driven by nonequilibrium phonons
summary: Driven nonequilibrium systems can host emergent functionalities beyond equilibrium, but real-time access to excited-state dynamics remains limited. Here we report real-time measurements of phonon-driven charge and spin dynamics in excited states of a double quantum dot. Under phonon irradiation, resonant inter-dot tunneling emerges at triplet resonance. Time-resolved charge sensing reveals that the resonant inter-dot tunneling is strongly modified by spin blockade. For weaker inter-dot coupling, the nonequilibrium phonon environment generates a unidirectional transport cycle along the phonon density gradient.

AI.tldr: 本文报道了在双量子点中实时测量声子驱动的电荷和自旋动力学。研究发现声子辐照下出现三重态共振的隧穿，时间分辨电荷传感揭示了自旋阻塞对共振隧穿的强烈影响，并在弱耦合下观察到沿声子密度梯度的单向输运循环。
AI.motivation: 非平衡驱动系统可以展现超越平衡态的新功能，但激发态动力学的实时获取仍受到限制。作者希望填补这一技术空白。
AI.method: 采用实时测量技术，在双量子点中通过声子辐照激发，利用时间分辨电荷传感观察电荷和自旋动力学。
AI.result: 1. 声子辐照下出现三重态共振的量子点间隧穿。2. 自旋阻塞显著调制共振隧穿。3. 弱耦合下非平衡声子环境产生沿声子密度梯度的单向输运循环。
AI.conclusion: 实现了对非平衡系统中激发态动力学的实时观测，揭示了声子驱动下量子点中电荷与自旋的新奇输运行为，为开发非平衡量子器件提供了新思路。

title: A general-purpose atomic cluster expansion interatomic potential for niobium
summary: Niobium, a body-centered cubic transition metal, poses a challenge for interatomic potentials, which struggle to capture its properties, such as phonons, high-pressure behavior, energy barriers to dislocation glide, and others. To tackle this challenge, we constructed a general-purpose atomic cluster expansion (ACE) potential for niobium. We trained our ACE on thousands of density functional theory (DFT) structures spanning a diversity of local environments. We validated it across a range of properties and compared it with existing empirical and machine learning (ML) potentials, including a novel universal ML potential. The resulting ACE balances accuracy, efficiency, and robustness, enabling large-scale exploration of niobium with near-DFT precision. Finally, our ACE held its own in a stringent test: a near-million-atom molecular dynamics simulation of fracture

AI.tldr: 本文构建了铌（Nb）的原子团簇展开（ACE）势，该势基于数千种密度泛函理论（DFT）结构训练，在精度、效率和鲁棒性上取得了平衡，能接近DFT精度地进行大规模铌原子模拟，并在近百万原子断裂动力学测试中表现良好。
AI.motivation: 铌作为体心立方过渡金属，其声子、高压行为、位错滑移能垒等特性难以被传统经验势和现有机器学习势准确描述，亟需一种通用且高精度的势函数。
AI.method: 基于原子团簇展开（ACE）框架，利用数千种涵盖多样局部环境的DFT结构进行训练，构建了面向铌的通用势函数。
AI.result: 该ACE势在多项性能验证中优于现有经验势和机器学习势（包括新一代通用机器学习势），并在近百万原子断裂模拟的严苛测试中表现出色。
AI.conclusion: 所构建的ACE势在精度、效率和鲁棒性之间取得了良好平衡，能够以接近DFT的精度支持大规模铌材料探索。

title: Real-time simulation of charge migration within the time-dependent Kohn-Sham DFT
summary: Attosecond technologies provide unique opportunities to study electron dynamics and electron correlation on their intrinsic timescales. From a theoretical perspective, this places strong constraints as an accurate treatment of electron correlation is required. Recently, it was demonstrated that time-dependent density-functional theory (TDDFT) is capable of correctly predicting correlation-driven charge migration arising from hole mixing following ionization of the highest occupied molecular orbital (HOMO). Given the ability of TDDFT to treat large-scale systems, this approach offers promising perspectives for investigating electron-correlation-driven mechanisms in complex molecules. In this work, we assessed the constraints and limitations associated with using TDDFT to study this mechanism. We found that the charge-migration dynamics are already correctly reproduced using local-density approximation for the exchange-correlation functional, provided the states involved in the coherent superposition are well described within the TDDFT. However, for dynamics triggered by the ionization of orbitals below the HOMO, artificial ultrafast dynamics may appear on top of the charge-migration dynamics. These artifacts indicate that careful analysis of the simulated dynamics is required in order to reliably predict phenomena that could be observed experimentally.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了TDDFT在描述由电子关联驱动的电荷迁移动力学中的能力与局限性，发现LDA泛函能正确再现HOMO电离后的动力学，但在电离低层轨道时可能出现人工超快动力学伪影。
AI.motivation: 阿秒技术需要在电子固有时间尺度上精确处理电子关联，TDDFT在处理大体系时具有优势，但需要系统评估其在这类关联驱动电荷迁移问题中的约束和局限性。
AI.method: 使用TDDFT方法，采用局域密度近似（LDA）交换关联泛函，模拟电离最高占据分子轨道（HOMO）及更低轨道后的电荷迁移动力学，分析不同情况下的动力学行为。
AI.result: LDA泛函可以正确再现HOMO电离后的电荷迁移动力学；但电离低于HOMO的轨道时，可能出现人工超快动力学伪影，叠加在真实的电荷迁移动力学之上。
AI.conclusion: 使用TDDFT研究关联驱动电荷迁移时，需要对模拟动力学进行仔细分析，以可靠预测实验可观测现象，避免伪影干扰。

title: The BiP-PRISM algorithm for fast and scalable core-loss STEM-EELS simulations
comment: 21 pages, 7 figures, 7 tables; includes supplementary material
summary: Quantitative interpretation of atomic-resolution STEM-EELS requires dynamical simulation of the electron probe before and after core-loss transitions, which is computationally expensive. While the PRISM algorithm accelerates this by reusing scattering matrices, we introduce beam partitioning for both the probe-forming ($\mathcal{S}_1$) and detector-propagating ($\mathcal{S}_2$) PRISM matrices to further reduce computational and memory costs. Each matrix is calculated on a sparse set of parent beams and reconstructed via natural-neighbor interpolation locally at the ionized atom. A locality result demonstrates that the total error is governed entirely by this on-atom reconstruction error. The resulting BiP-PRISM algorithm removes per-scan exit wave propagation and significantly reduces memory requirements, enabling full-resolution elemental mapping, 4D cubes, and momentum-resolved qEELS on consumer-grade GPUs. We characterize the approximation's validity regime and demonstrate the simulation of a multimodal five-edge oxide-interface map and an FePt nanoparticle Fe-L map at 5x memory reduction, showing that the algorithm achieves high accuracy with significantly lower computational demands.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BiP-PRISM算法，通过对探针形成和探测器传播矩阵进行波束分区与自然邻域插值，大幅降低了STEM-EELS定量模拟的计算和内存开销，首次实现消费级GPU上的全分辨率元素映射。
AI.motivation: 原子分辨率的STEM-EELS定量模拟需要核心损耗跃迁前后电子探针的动力学模拟，计算成本极高。现有PRISM算法虽通过复用散射矩阵加速，但内存和计算开销仍然较大，亟需进一步优化。
AI.method: 对PRISM算法中的两个散射矩阵（探针形成矩阵S1和探测器传播矩阵S2）分别进行波束分区（beam partitioning），仅在稀疏母波束上计算，再通过自然邻域插值在电离原子局部位置重构完整波束集，避免了逐扫描点的出射波传播计算。
AI.result: 理论证明了总误差完全由原子位置上的重构误差决定。实验展示了五边氧化物界面图和FePt纳米颗粒Fe-L图的模拟，在5倍内存缩减下保持高精度，可在消费级GPU上运行。
AI.conclusion: BiP-PRISM算法在保持高精度的前提下显著降低了计算和内存需求，拓展了PRISM框架的适用范围，使复杂多边元素映射和动量分辨qEELS模拟更加可及。

title: Strongly frustrated 2D magnetism in a 3D hexagonal perovskite
summary: Exotic quantum phenomena are often found to occur in spin systems that exhibit low-dimensional magnetism. By combining nuclear magnetic resonance, neutron scattering, and muon-spin spectroscopy ($μ$SR) techniques, we report a rare instance of strongly frustrated two-dimensional (2D) magnetism in a three-dimensional (3D) hexagonal perovskite. Here, Ba$_2$La$_2$MnTe$_2$O$_{12}$, a triangular-lattice magnet, is shown to undergo a magnetic transition at $T_\mathrm{N} \approx$ 4.4 K, below which the manganese moments form a 120$^{\circ}$ AFM order within the $ab$-plane, while staying disordered along the $c$-axis. This exotic ground state, which exhibits ideal 2D magnetism, is highly consistent with the persistently strong spin fluctuations and the large internal field distributions revealed by zero-field $μ$SR. Further, the 2D magnetism also leads to a significant frustration, much larger than that of most known magnetically-ordered frustrated systems. Our work on Ba$_2$La$_2$MnTe$_2$O$_{12}$ not only challenges the interpretations of magnetic order in other 3D hexagonal perovskites, but it also provides insight into how the dimensionality affects the exotic magnetic states.

AI.tldr: 本文通过核磁共振、中子散射和μ子自旋光谱技术，发现三维六方钙钛矿Ba₂La₂MnTe₂O₁₂存在罕见的强阻挫二维磁性行为。该材料在ab面内形成120°反铁磁有序，而c轴方向保持无序，表现出理想二维磁性，并伴随强自旋涨落和大内场分布。
AI.motivation: 探索低维磁性系统中可能存在的奇特量子现象，特别是寻找三维材料中实现二维磁性的罕见实例，并理解维度对奇特磁态的影响。
AI.method: 结合核磁共振（NMR）、中子散射和μ子自旋光谱（μSR）三种实验技术，对Ba₂La₂MnTe₂O₁₂三角晶格磁体进行系统表征。
AI.result: 该材料在TN≈4.4 K发生磁相变，Mn磁矩在ab面内形成120°反铁磁有序，c轴方向保持无序；零场μSR显示持续强自旋涨落和大内场分布，证实为理想二维磁性系统，且阻挫程度显著高于大多数已知磁有序阻挫系统。
AI.conclusion: 该工作挑战了对其他三维六方钙钛矿磁有序的传统解释，并为理解维度如何影响奇特磁态提供了新见解。

title: Universal Short-Imaginary-Time Quantum Critical Dynamics Near Boundaries
summary: While imaginary-time evolution has long served as a standard paradigm for ground-state preparation in numerical simulations and quantum devices, its intrinsic dynamical properties has been largely overlooked. Here, we investigate the short-imaginary-time critical dynamics in quantum systems with boundaries. A universal scaling theory is developed and verified in the two-dimensional quantum Ising model, uncovering rich dynamic critical behaviors dictated by boundary universality classes. For ordered initial states, the boundary order parameter $M_s$ decays with imaginary time $τ$ as $M_s \propto τ^{-β_1/νz}$, where $β_1$ denotes the boundary order parameter exponent, and $ν$ and $z$ correspond to the correlation length exponent and the dynamic exponent, respectively. For disordered initial states, the autocorrelation of the boundary order parameter is governed by a novel critical exponent $θ_1$, which is closely related to the critical initial slip behavior of $M_s$ characterized by the corresponding exponent $θ_1'$. In contrast to its positive bulk counterpart, the boundary initial-slip exponent $θ_1'$ is negative for the ordinary transition while remaining positive for the special transition. Although the static universality classes of $d$-dimensional quantum phase transitions generally coincide with those of $(d+1)$-dimensional classical phase transitions, we show that $θ_1$ does not follow this conventional quantum-classical mapping. We further discuss the implications of our results for more exotic forms of boundary criticality. Our findings provide new physical insights into boundary critical dynamics and offer a novel route for probing exotic boundary critical behaviors in quantum many-body systems.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了量子系统中虚时演化的边界临界动力学，提出了普适标度理论，并在二维量子Ising模型中验证。发现了由边界序参量指数β₁、关联长度指数ν和动力学指数z控制的临界衰变行为，以及新的边界临界指数θ₁和θ₁'，并揭示了θ₁不遵循传统的量子-经典映射关系。
AI.motivation: 虚时演化是基态制备的标准方法，但其内在的动力学性质长期被忽视。本文旨在探索含边界的量子系统中短虚时临界动力学行为，揭示边界临界动力学的新物理。
AI.method: 发展了边界临界动力学的普适标度理论，并以二维量子Ising模型为平台进行验证。分析了有序初始态和无序初始态下边界序参量的虚时演化行为，推导了标度关系。
AI.result: 发现有序初始态下边界序参量M_s∝τ^{-β₁/νz}；无序初始态下自关联函数由新临界指数θ₁控制，边界初始滑移指数θ₁'在ordinary transition为负、在special transition为正；θ₁不遵循d维量子相变与(d+1)维经典相变的常规映射关系。
AI.conclusion: 提供了量子多体系统中边界临界动力学的新物理见解，并为探测奇异边界临界行为提供了新途径。

title: Characterization of Hydroxyls in Surface Oxide of Superconducting Tantalum and Their Mitigation in Quantum Circuits
summary: Recently, tantalum (Ta) has gained attention in superconducting quantum circuits due to the longer coherence times achieved when replacing niobium (Nb) in capacitor pads. Previous literature shows that surface oxides that form upon ambient exposure on superconducting metals such as Ta, Al, and Nb host two-level system (TLS) defects, which are a leading source of microwave loss and decoherence. While the surface oxides of Nb and Al have been extensively studied, Ta oxides remain less well understood. Using secondary ion mass spectrometry of alpha-Ta films deposited at 300 mm wafer scale, we show for the first time that hydroxyls accumulate in the Ta suboxide region above the underlying Ta. Angle-resolved X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy shows that the surface region is dominated by Ta2O5, with sub-stoichiometric TaOx present in between the Ta2O5 and underlying Ta. The thickness of the tantalum oxide is confirmed by transmission electron microscopy. We demonstrate that [OH] incorporation can be suppressed by replacing the native oxide with an oxide formed during chemical mechanical planarization of alpha-Ta films. Our findings support the hypothesis that TLS defects are non-uniform within the oxide thickness and suggest hydroxyls as a probable molecular origin of these loss channels. Furthermore, we show the feasibility of plasma nitridization as a method to decrease hydroxyl loading on alpha-Ta surfaces. The modulation of hydroxyl content through surface engineering of alpha-Ta can enable the fabrication of more robust, high-coherence superconducting quantum circuits by addressing a potential TLS source.

AI.tldr: 本文通过SIMS、XPS、TEM等手段首次证明α-Ta薄膜的表面氧化物中存在羟基（OH）积累，并发现这些羟基是导致超导量子电路中二能级系统（TLS）损耗的关键因素。研究提出通过化学机械平坦化（CMP）和等离子体氮化可有效抑制羟基掺入，为制造高相干性超导量子电路提供了新途径。
AI.motivation: 钽（Ta）在超导量子电路中因取代铌（Nb）展现出更长的相干时间，但其表面氧化物的性质尚不明确。由于表面氧化物中的TLS缺陷是微波损耗和退相干的主要来源，而Al和Nb的氧化物已被广泛研究，Ta的氧化物仍缺乏深入理解，因此本文旨在探究Ta表面氧化物的结构、羟基分布及其与TLS缺陷的关联。
AI.method: 采用二次离子质谱（SIMS）对300 mm晶圆级α-Ta薄膜进行羟基分布分析；利用角分辨X射线光电子能谱（ARXPS）表征表面氧化物化学态（Ta₂O₅、亚化学计量TaOₓ）；通过透射电子显微镜（TEM）确认氧化层厚度；对比原生氧化物与CMP形成氧化物中羟基含量的差异；并测试等离子体氮化对羟基负载的调控效果。
AI.result: 首次发现羟基积累在Ta亚氧化物区（Ta₂O₅与α-Ta之间）；CMP形成的氧化物能有效抑制羟基掺入；等离子体氮化可降低α-Ta表面的羟基含量；证实TLS缺陷在氧化物厚度内非均匀分布，羟基很可能是其分子起源。

title: Robustness of Quantum Discord in Nonequilibrium Electronic Transport through Tunnel-Coupled Quantum Dots
summary: Quantum discord captures quantum correlations beyond entanglement and can remain finite even when the entanglement vanishes. We investigate the transient nonequilibrium dynamics and steady-state behavior of quantum discord and classical correlations in a double quantum dot (DQD) system coupled to fermionic reservoirs. By employing a quantum Langevin equation formalism, we obtain the exact reduced density matrix of the system, enabling a comprehensive analysis of its quantum and classical correlations under nonequilibrium conditions. The influence of system-reservoir coupling strength, spectral bandwidth, thermal bias, and varying initial state on both the transient dynamics and steady-state correlations is systematically analyzed. Quantum discord remains finite in the nonequilibrium steady state over a broad parameter range. Although thermal gradients reduce the overall magnitude of correlations, quantum discord persists and exhibits greater resilience. These results demonstrate that nonequilibrium electronic transport, together with the environmental spectral properties and reservoir asymmetry, provides an effective means of controlling nonclassical correlations in mesoscopic systems and establishes quantum discord as a robust hallmark of open fermionic quantum devices.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了双量子点系统中量子失协在非平衡态下的动力学行为，发现即使在纠缠消失时，量子失协仍保持有限，且对环境参数具有鲁棒性。

title: Entropy-Driven Structural Phase Transition in Nb$_3$Cl$_8$ via Density Functional Theory and an Effective Model
comment: 14 pages, 9 figures, including 5 pages of supplemental material
summary: As a prototypical flat-band cluster Mott insulator on an effective triangular lattice, Nb$_3$Cl$_8$ is a potential candidate for hosting a quantum spin liquid (QSL) state. Nevertheless, a first-order structural phase transition around 90K transforms the high-temperature paramagnetic $α$ phase into the low-temperature nonmagnetic $β$ phase, suppressing the candidate QSL regime of the $α$ phase. To clarify the microscopic origin of this transition, we combine first-principles calculations with an extended Hubbard model to construct a unified free-energy framework. This framework reveals that the transition is jointly driven by phonon and spin entropy: the $α$ phase is stabilized by softer phonons and larger paramagnetic spin entropy, whereas the $β$ phase is favored by interlayer dimerization, which hardens the phonons and quenches the spin entropy through singlet formation. Furthermore, by evaluating the pressure-dependent generalized enthalpy, we provide a thermodynamic explanation for the suppression of the transition under c-axis uniaxial pressure, where stabilizing the $α$ phase may allow the candidate QSL regime of the $α$ phase to be explored at low temperatures.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过第一性原理计算和扩展Hubbard模型，揭示了Nb₃Cl₈中α-β结构相变由声子和自旋熵共同驱动，并解释了c轴单轴压力可抑制该相变、稳定α相以探索量子自旋液体态。
AI.motivation: Nb₃Cl₈的α相是潜在的量子自旋液体候选材料，但约90K的结构相变使其转变为非磁性的β相，抑制了QSL态的出现。作者希望澄清该相变的微观起源，并探索如何抑制相变以保留α相的低温柔磁性QSL区间。
AI.method: 将第一性原理计算与扩展Hubbard模型相结合，构建统一的自由能框架，并评估压力依赖的广义焓。

AI.conclusion: 该相变是声子熵和自旋熵共同驱动的结果，通过施加c轴单轴压力可以抑制相变，从而在低温下探索α相的潜在量子自旋液体行为。

title: Dynamics of charge fluctuations in nanocapacitors: effects of salt concentration and electrode metallicity from Brownian dynamics
summary: Electric double-layer capacitors (EDLCs) rely on the dynamical response of confined electrolytes to store and release charge, yet the interplay between ion transport, electrostatic interactions, and electrode metallicity remains poorly understood at the nanoscale. We develop a comprehensive Brownian dynamics framework to compute the frequency-dependent admittance of nanocapacitors, explicitly accounting for salt concentration and the finite screening length of electrodes (modeled via Thomas-Fermi theory). We derive the fluctuation-dissipation relation connecting the dynamics of equilibrium charge fluctuations to the linear response of the system quantified by the frequency-dependent admittance. Specifically, we obtain two estimators for the admittance, based on ionic positions and forces, and combine them via a control variate method to reduce uncertainty across all frequencies. We show that the admittance exhibits a low-frequency regime dominated by capacitive effects, and a high-frequency one governed by the ideal Nernst-Einstein conductivity. The crossover between these regimes is characterized by a timescale that depends on both the electrode metallicity and salt concentration, highlighting the role of ion-wall collisions and electrostatic interactions. Comparisons with analytical models show that while mean-field theories capture qualitative trends, they systematically overestimate low-frequency admittance and underestimate high-frequency behavior, underscoring the necessity of explicit ion-ion and ion-wall interactions. This work connects microscopic dynamics to macroscopic electrochemical observables, offering a tool to interpret impedance spectra in nanoscale systems. Beyond charge storage in EDLCs, our framework provides insights for sensing applications in nanofluidic devices, where charge/current fluctuations enable the detection of electrochemically active species.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个布朗动力学框架，用于计算纳米电容器的频率依赖导纳，明确考虑了盐浓度和电极的有限屏蔽长度（通过Thomas-Fermi理论建模），并推导了涨落-耗散关系。研究发现导纳在低频区以电容效应为主，高频区由理想Nernst-Einstein电导主导，其交叉时间尺度依赖于电极金属性和盐浓度。与平均场理论相比，显式考虑离子-离子和离子-壁相互作用是必要的。

AI.method: 建立了布朗动力学框架，结合Thomas-Fermi理论处理电极的有限屏蔽长度；推导了涨落-耗散关系，将平衡电荷涨落动力学与频率依赖导纳的线性响应联系起来；基于离子位置和力构建了两个导纳估计量，并通过控制变量法降低不确定性。

title: Quantum Oscillations of $\mathrm{Sr}_2\mathrm{RuO}_4$ under c-Axis Uniaxial Stress
summary: Uniaxial stress has now been widely used to study correlated electron materials. However, Fermi surface-resolved experimental data on the evolution of the electronic structure under piezoelectrically applied stress are sparse, with no reports of de Haas-van Alphen (dHvA) effects under uniaxial stress. Here we present dHvA measurements under $c$-axis uniaxial stress on the unconventional superconductor $\mathrm{Sr}_2\mathrm{RuO}_4$. This allows us to study the evolution of the electronic structure directly and to gain insight into the contradicting behavior of the predicted enhancement of the electronic density of states and the observed suppression of $T_\text{c}$. We are able to follow all Fermi surfaces for stress up to $-1.8$~GPa and find that the cross-sectional areas of the hole-like $α$ sheet increase and electron-like $β$ sheet decrease. At the same time, the area of the electron-like $γ$ sheet increases. Therefore, in contrast to in-plane uniaxial stress, charge transfer is the mechanism for approaching the electron-to-hole Lifshitz transition and the associated Van Hove singularity. Additionally, we find that the effective masses on all three Fermi sheets are slightly enhanced as the Lifshitz transition is approached. We compare the dHvA results with quantum oscillations in the magnetostriction and band structure calculations, and find good agreement. At a more general level, our findings show that quantum oscillation measurements under uniaxial stress, combined with band-structure calculations, offer a promising new route for studying quantum materials.

AI.tldr: 本文首次实现了在单轴应力下的dHvA效应测量，以Sr₂RuO₄为研究对象，追踪了所有费米面在c轴单轴应力下的演化，发现空穴型α和电子型γ费米面面积增大，电子型β减小，电荷转移是趋近Lifshitz转变的机制，有效质量轻微增强。实验与磁致伸缩振荡和能带计算吻合良好，证明单轴应力下的量子振荡测量是研究量子材料的新途径。
AI.motivation: 单轴应力已被广泛用于研究关联电子材料，但缺乏压电施加应力下电子结构演变的费米面分辨实验数据，尤其是单轴应力下的dHvA效应尚无报道。本文旨在填补这一空白，通过测量Sr₂RuO₄在c轴单轴应力下的dHvA效应，直接研究电子结构演化，并解释电子态密度增强与Tc抑制之间的矛盾行为。

AI.result: 空穴型α费米面面积增加，电子型β费米面面积减小，电子型γ费米面面积增加；所有三个费米面的有效质量在趋近Lifshitz转变时略微增强；dHvA结果与磁致伸缩量子振荡及能带计算吻合良好。
